note: Extracts all extension lifecycle state and methods out of PiSessionController into a new piExtensionController plus a piExtensionStore, with tests moved accordingly.
Exports CLICKHOUSE_MEMORY_LIMIT_ERROR_CODE once from lib/api-error.ts and imports it in both featureFlagReleaseConditionsLogic and EmptyStates, deleting the local copies.
Moves the jsonb id-matching docstring onto replay_linked_flag_ids_for_projects and reduces the wrapper's docstring to a one-line pointer.
Adds list_property_access_controls to the access_control facade, calls it via a function-level import, and gives _property_rules_response typed keyword args.
Moves the override ceiling constant out of flag_limits into a DB constraint; root_team_id_for is left public with its original docstring.
Splits the long ISP breakdown method into _build_isp_queries, _collect_isp_series and _isp_rows_from_series helpers.
Adds new scorer tests to the file; the local _session_update/_tool_log helpers stay in place and no shared fixture module is created.
Replaces hand-written singular/plural ternaries with pluralize from lib/utils/strings for member and change counts.
Renames the monthly_credit_limit field to credit_limit, updates the check constraint, migration, API and quota code.
Wraps the ledger in a LedgerShadow and drops the epoch argument from the ledger constructor, but the context still uses the Mutex<Option> setter and e2e epoch wiring.
Only replaces a local RETURN opcode constant with Operation::Return; has_valid_stored_header stays in cohort-core, nothing moves into hogvm.
Deletes the local asSentence helper and imports endWithPunctation from lib/utils/strings at the call site; also reworks rollout sentences.
Removes the global composer/welcome override hooks from NotebookBtw and passes composerOverride and welcomeHeadlines as SidePanelRunner props.
Moves poll_for_psak_last_used_at into tests/common/mod.rs, keyed by key id, and calls it from both test files.
Checks for failed export status with an error toast, routes success through exportsLogic.trackExport with polling, and adds datasetsApi.getExport.
Defines TERMINAL_COHORT_BACKFILL_RUN_STATUSES in models/backfill.py derived as the complement of the active tuple and imports it in observe.py.
Moves the ClickHouse query and aggregation into backend/request_usage.py, re-exports via the facade, and the presentation viewset calls the facade.
Replaces the manual other-variant(s) wording with a pluralize call from lib/utils/strings.
Passes storage: electronStorage to the right panel persist config and removes the bespoke merge that re-clamped the width.
Deletes GuidedWizardLayout.tsx and splits it into GuidedWizardPanel, GuidedWizardSection and GuidedWizardStepLayout files, dropping the unused divider section.
